ruleDefinitions.name: System Network Connections Discovery Via Net.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of network connections to or from the compromised system they are currently accessing or from remote systems by querying for information over the network.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "net\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net1\.exe")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX("\\ use$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ sessions$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ use\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ sessions\\ .*"))))
